retained_actual_claims.own_source_context: 每天5分钟，轻松学编程。 这是《5分钟学编程 · Javascript篇》第21集，带你正式进入 JavaScript 中最常用的引用数据类型 —— 数组。 本集内容包含：数组的基本结构、索引（从 0 开始）的概念，如何通过索引访问与修改数组元素，以及 const 与 let 在数组声明时的区别，帮助你理解数组在内存中的引用特性。 👉 下一集：《#22 数组的操作》

integration_requirements: Every positive path must require validate_reviewed, including old raw judge cache/matches, literal fallback and GET reprojection. Merely adding the module does not update the existing bad result cards.

Valid rejected/omitted/over-cap claims become source-bound empty supports. A review failure None must stay unknown and cannot fall back to a positive raw judgment or literal support; do not cache it as a successful positive review.
Enforce at most one review per persisted job progress, in addition to at most two judge calls, and the parent 240-second deadline/reserved 45-second phase budget.

GET must never call either model; cache keys retain exact source/point/skill/stage binding and review VERSION. ReadRankCache must include the sealed decision/version/status in its existing full input hash.
The SHA review seal is local integrity/version binding, not an authenticated model verdict or authorization token. Do not expose a client route that can submit arbitrary sealed decisions.
limitations: Only three previously audited claims were used by the one retained real model control. The review prompt includes general examples of these failure types; this is a known-sample correction, not independent unseen-case accuracy.
The same model family may make correlated semantic mistakes on other subjects; unseen project evidence and manual review remain necessary.
Quote-local context can conservatively reject a true method whose essential explanation is elsewhere; it never permits inventing missing evidence.
